definition: [ כָּתַת ] verb beat, crush by beating (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic כְּתַת ); — Qal Perfect 1 singular וְכַתּוֺתִ֫י Ps 89:24 Imperfect 1 singular וָאֶבֹּת Deut 9:21 Imperative masculine plural כֹּ֫תּוּ Joel 4:10 Passive participle כָּתוּת Isa 30:14 ; Lev 22:24 — 1. beat or crush fine , of a potter's vessel Isa 30:14 , the golden calf Deut 9:21 (+ טָחוֺן הֵיטֵב ); a sacrificial vicitim Lev 22:24 (i.e. its testicles; + מָעוּךְ נָתוּק כָּרוּת ); figurative of enemies Ps 89:24 . 2. beat, hammer (ploughshares into swords, compare Pi`el 2 ) Joel 4:10 . Pi`el Perfect 3 masculine singular כִּתַּת 2Kgs 18:4 ; 2Chr 34:7 3 masculine plural וְכִּתְּתוּ consecutive Isa 2:4 + 2 t.; — as Qal 1. beat or crush fine 2Kgs 18:4 ; 2Chr 34:7 (of images); figurative of devastating the land Zech 11:6 . 2. beat, hammer (swords into ploughshares, compare Qal 2 ) Isa 2:4 = Mic 4:3 . Pu`al Perfect 3 masculine plural וְכֻתְּתוּ 2Chr 15:6 and they were beaten in pieces , one nation against another. Hiph`il Imperfect 3 masculine plural וַיַּכְּתוּ Deut 1:44 beat in pieces an enemy, suffix וַיַּכּוּם וַיַּכְּתוּם Num 14:45 . Hoph`al Imperfect 3 masculine singular וּשְׁאִיָּה יֻכַּתשָֿׁ֑עַר Isa 24:12 and to ruins is the gate crushed ; 3 masculine plural יֻכַּתּוּ Mic 1:7 (of idol-images); figurative of warriors Jer 46:5 of frail man Job 4:20 .
